note: Brief 008 B6 frame-time stops (Latch, 2026-10-14). GDD §11: 60 fps at 1080p on the MacBook Air M4, measured warm, in a development build. Foci are world points (Unity x, y, z = plan x, level, plan y); y is the level (0 street, 9.43 deck). zoom 0 = the play camera's own (14). PerfBuild resolves stand-offs with Rig.StandOff and the play camera's rotation (pitch 38, yaw 30). Redline review 008 B6 (out/review/008-b6-perf.html): passes, variants (A/B switches), warm-up to a plateau, rotated repeats, per-frame CSV; the sweep after a warm-up, by frame time, with the decks. B6 second pass (Latch): fixes 1 and 3 ship (SSAO from depth after opaques, 2 cascades); fix 2 (LOD1 shadow proxies) is built but held off; the fade's discard reaches only 16 m fade cells (kit.json fadeCell). PerfPlanner appends to `content` the roots built and the people, read from the scene: the people layer is stripped unless the build asks for it (PerfStrip; Redline 2026-10-15 M3). Variants name every switch, so `as-was` sets the switches of the build before B6 in any player; it runs on the scene the player was built with (B6 geometry: Redline 2026-10-15 M4). Air run (Aster, 2026-10-14): as-was, 1+3, +proxies, +fade in reach, +fade off, +SSAO off, +SSAO off and fade in reach.
content: world: buildings, structures, street furniture and bays; no vehicles or sim (not built yet)

variants.name: as-was
variants.why: as-was (emulated on B6 geometry): the switches of the build before B6 (ab-1's base: SSAO from the depth-normals prepass, 4 cascades, every LOD casts, the fade's discard on whole 64 m tiles) on the B6 scene, which keeps its 16 m fade cells, uncompressed vertices (VertexChannelCompressionMask 0) and the crossing light's emission copy. Not the pre-B6 player: a headline B6 gain needs a paired Air run with the player built from the parent of 0f4d4d6 (Redline 2026-10-15 M4)

variants.name: base
variants.why: as built (since B6: SSAO from depth after opaques, 2 cascades, proxies built but off, the fade's discard only on the cells it reaches)

variants.name: fixes-13
variants.why: fixes 1 and 3 (SSAO from depth, 2 cascades), the fade as before B6 (whole tiles), no proxies

variants.name: fixes-13-proxies
variants.why: 1+3 and fix 2: kit facades and street trees cast from their LOD1 proxy (held: the Air decides)

variants.name: fixes-13-reach
variants.why: 1+3 and the fade in reach (Redline item 9): the discarding variant only on the fade cells the cut reaches; equals base

variants.name: fixes-13-fadeoff
variants.why: 1+3 without the fade: the bound for item 9

variants.name: fixes-13-ssaooff-reach
variants.why: 1+3, SSAO off and the fade in reach: Glint's proposal with the best fade case

passes.name: ab
passes.why: headroom and A/B (Redline M1, item 0): uncapped, the switches Aster set for the Air run (2026-10-14) back to back at every stop, 3 rotated repeats, the first segment again at the end; as-was first, so every delta is against the switches before B6 on B6 geometry (the cell split's own cost is in no delta)

passes.name: capped
passes.why: reference (Redline M1): vSync on at the display, fullscreen window, 60 s a stop; a frame past 25 ms (1.5 refresh intervals at 60 Hz) missed its vblank. vSync on macOS paces frames 15.7-17.7 ms round 16.67 without missing one: the first run counted that jitter at 17.5 ms

passes.name: pan
passes.why: a moving camera and a level change (Redline section 6), uncapped

passes.name: counts
passes.why: machine-independent counts only (Aster, 2026-10-14: the Studio's timings say nothing of the Air): every variant at every stop, 1 s each, drawer per-view draws, SetPass, triangles, shadow casters and a shot; run with -perfNoWarm; frame times are not read

passes.name: look
passes.why: Glint's warmth question (2026-10-14): the home frame as built, in a 1920x1080 window, one shot, and the grade, ambient and sun the player resolves (report `look`); timing not read
